nodes.label: RegisterUser Use Case
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates the registration of a new tenant account holder, including password hashing and OTP generation.

nodes.label: VerifyEmail Use Case
nodes.rationale: Handles the verification of a user's email address using a provided OTP.

nodes.label: LoginUser Use Case
nodes.rationale: Authenticates a user with email and password, handling TOTP requirements and token generation.

nodes.label: SetupTOTP Use Case
nodes.rationale: Generates a TOTP secret and provisioning URI for enabling 2FA.

nodes.label: ConfirmTOTP Use Case
nodes.rationale: Confirms the TOTP setup by verifying a code and enabling 2FA for the user.

nodes.label: VerifyTOTP Use Case
nodes.rationale: Verifies the TOTP code during the login flow to provide a full access token.
